ideas.title: Weekend market stall of baked staples (east)
ideas.one_liner: Weekend market crowds pay for a small stall selling 3 signature bakes made from one cheap base dough.
steps: Bake 25 samples and price-test on friends
Book one weekend market stall
Get the food-handler certificate
Offer $15 three-pack box with a 3-bake box
Post the Saturday menu in local groups
Take pre-orders via a simple form
Track which bake sells out first
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Check cottage-food rules for home kitchens
Never sell perishables without cold storage
Price with the stall fee included
